## What happened

Change notice CHG-0240 records the implementation of Outreach camera firmware 3.1.0 at River Outreach. The change started on 2025-02-03. This notice provides a concise record of the change and its operational context.

## Cause

The change was required to apply the Supplier patch. The firmware update was introduced as part of that supplier-provided correction. No other cause is recorded in this notice.

## Effect

The expected effect is that Image quality improves; vendor scores shift. The service desk can provide assistance with questions about this notice. When making an enquiry, quote CHG-0240 so that the relevant change record can be identified.
